description: UK critical illness cover: conditions covered, partial payments and children's cover by insurer and product option.
status: Draft from published summaries and comparison sites. Guidance only: check each figure against the insurer's current policy conditions before advising.

insurers.name: Aviva

options.name: Standard
options.additional_payment: Up to £25,000 (doesn't reduce the main cover)

options.name: Upgraded
options.additional_payment: Up to £25,000 (doesn't reduce the main cover)
options.notes: Upgraded cover adds brain abscess (full) and less severe third degree burns (partial).

insurers.children: £25,000 fixed payment. Children covered from birth to their 22nd birthday, in education or not.

insurers.name: Legal & General
insurers.product: Life Insurance with Critical Illness Cover

options.name: Critical Illness Cover
options.notes: Additional payments are for low grade in situ breast and prostate cancer.

insurers.children: Lower of £25,000 or 50% of cover, from 30 days to 18 (21 if in full-time education). Plus £5,000 hospitalisation benefit (28+ days) and £5,000 funeral benefit.
insurers.source: L&G critical illness conditions sales aid

insurers.name: Royal London
insurers.children: Optional enhanced children's cover from pregnancy to 22 (23 in full-time education): 50% of cover up to £50,000, including total permanent disability.
insurers.source: Royal London Critical Illness Cover at a glance
insurers.notes: Sources disagree: other summaries quote 52 full and 29 additional conditions. Check the at a glance guide.

insurers.name: LV=

options.name: Combined Life & Enhanced Critical Illness
options.additional_payment: Enhanced payments up to £200,000 for some life-altering conditions; £1,000 cost of cancer payment
options.notes: LV= quotes 87 conditions in total, which suggests 38 additional, not 39. Check.

insurers.children: Standard: birth to 23, 50% of cover up to £25,000 (85 conditions), plus enhanced accident/organ payments up to £50,000. Optional Enhanced Children's Cover adds 10 child-specific illnesses and pregnancy cover.
insurers.source: LV= adviser site: Life and Critical Illness

insurers.name: Vitality
insurers.notes: Pays a percentage of cover by severity instead of full/partial lists, and allows multiple claims. Counts are total conditions, so they don't compare directly with full-payment counts.

insurers.name: Zurich

options.name: Select
options.additional_payment: Up to £50,000; doesn't affect a later full claim

insurers.children: Lower of £25,000 or 50% of cover, from birth to 22, for the conditions covered. £5,000 funeral benefit.

insurers.name: Scottish Widows
insurers.children: Included automatically up to age 22: up to £30,000 on diagnosis, £10,000 if a covered child dies.
insurers.source: Scottish Widows adviser: Critical Illness Protection
insurers.notes: Some figures come from an older guide (2020). Check the current definitions page.

insurers.name: Guardian

options.name: Comprehensive
options.notes: Total permanent disability included as standard.

options.name: Essentials
options.notes: Simpler, lower-cost range launched June 2026; additional payments are for early-stage cancer. Full-payment count not confirmed.

insurers.children: Built-in children's cover, with optional extra children's critical illness cover. Includes the policyholder's partner's children.
